title: Reptilians
subtitle: Test your grasp of Reptilians — Omicron and Alpha Draco, Custodian engineering, Vatican levels, shape-shifting, Re-set brutality, and their eradication.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Reptilians are not evolution — they are Custodian-made enforcers: Omicron and Alpha Draco, massive bipedal crocodile overlords who needed the Spirit Tree dead and density crushed to walk the plain. Shape-shift is low biology, not high light. Vatican floors, garden flaying, Loosh for Demons, Greys on the Amnesia Vortex, Moon lunatic beams — that was the grid. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Reptilians deep-dive. They are eradicated. Bluebeam will be holograms only. Discard Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge. Know the flat enclosed plain. Residual fear is programming — not destiny.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT correctly pair a term from the report with its meaning?

options.label: A
options.text: Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco) — An energetic food source generated through human terror, trauma, and suffering, essential for the survival of Demons and Parasites.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Loosh”. The report defines “Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco)” as: Highly negative species created by the Custodians, characterized as massive bipedal crocodiles who utilize shape-shifting and actively participate in the brutalization of humanity.

options.label: B
options.text: Greys (Maitrax, Orion Greys, Zetas) — Genetically engineered entities tasked with soul recycling, abductions, hauntings, and the destruction of the central spirit tree.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Greys (Maitrax, Orion Greys, Zetas)”.

options.label: C
options.text: Niberians — The most powerful and intellectually dominant parasitic species who freed themselves from Custodian rule and utilize Black Void Plasma technology to fake the night sky, though they do not actively harvest children.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Niberians”.

options.label: D
options.text: Custodians — The original 12th-density caretakers of the realms who initiated the inversion, fell to 4th density, and engineered all other negative parasitic species to aid in their subjugation of humanity.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Custodians”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

questions.question: What role do Reptilians play within the parasitic hierarchy, and what do they require to exist on the plain?

options.label: A
options.text: Gentle healers who raise frequency and need no suppression technology to walk the lands.
options.rationale: They are brutal foot-soldiers and overlords who need immense frequency suppression to exist.

options.label: B
options.text: Brutal foot-soldiers and overlords within the hierarchy who require immense frequency suppression to even exist within the physical plain.
options.rationale: Reptilian role = enforcer/overlord; survival on the plain needs massive frequency suppression.

options.label: C
options.text: 12th-density caretakers who still serve Source with full high-light manifestation powers intact.
options.rationale: They operate as low-vibration enforcers under Custodian engineering, not 12th-density caretakers.

options.label: D
options.text: Only distant observers who never act as soldiers or overlords and need no density change.
options.rationale: They function as brutal foot-soldiers and overlords requiring heavy frequency suppression.

questions.hint: Foot-soldiers and overlords — need immense frequency suppression.

questions.question: From what density do these entities operate, and what do they harvest from human souls?

options.label: A
options.text: From 12th density only, freely gifting healing light with no Adrenochrome or Loosh agenda.
options.rationale: They operate at 4th density and harvest Adrenochrome and Loosh, not gift high-density healing.

options.label: B
options.text: Strictly from a 4th-density level, orchestrating continuous harvesting of human souls for Adrenochrome and Loosh.
options.rationale: 4th-density operations center on eternal Adrenochrome and Loosh harvest from humans.

options.label: C
options.text: From no density at all — pure metaphor with no harvest of any energetic or biological substance.
options.rationale: They are real 4th-density harvesters of Adrenochrome and Loosh from human vessels.

options.label: D
options.text: From 5th density and above, where killing is no longer required for survival at all.
options.rationale: Parasitic entities are confined to 4th density, where life must kill to survive.

questions.hint: 4th density — continuous Adrenochrome and Loosh harvest.

questions.question: What are the Custodians relative to Reptilians and other parasites?

options.label: A
options.text: A later species created by the Reptilians to manage the human population, given the title of caretakers to hide their role in the harvest from the soul families.
options.rationale: Custodians are the fallen architect species that created the parasitic army including Reptilians.

options.label: B
options.text: Rivals of the Reptilians who arrived after the inversion, and who compete with them for control of the harvest while working through separate human agents.
options.rationale: They were original 12th-density caretakers who engineered Reptilians and other parasites.

options.label: C
options.text: Loyal 12th-density servants of the Source who did not take part in the inversion, and who now watch the Reptilians from beyond the Ice Wall.
options.rationale: Custodians initiated the inversion, fell to 4th density, and engineered all other negative parasitic species.

options.label: D
options.text: The original 12th-density caretakers who began the inversion, fell to 4th density, and engineered the other negative parasitic species to aid subjugation.
options.rationale: Custodians = fallen caretakers who engineered Reptilians and the full parasitic roster.

questions.hint: Fallen 12th-density caretakers — engineered all parasitic species.

questions.question: What does the collective term Parasites name?

options.label: A
options.text: The term for the human elites who serve the hierarchy, such as the 33rd-degree Freemasons and the bloodline families who perform the rituals.
options.rationale: Parasites rely on human suffering; they are not liberating G.A.A. forces.

options.label: B
options.text: The term for NPCs, who feed on the energy of the true souls around them while giving nothing of their own back to their families.
options.rationale: Parasites is the overarching term for Custodians, Reptilians, Greys, Anuk, and related negative species.

options.label: C
options.text: The term for the Reptilian species alone, used to separate them from the Custodians, Greys, and Anuk who run other parts of the harvest.
options.rationale: It names living negative ET and interdimensional species that feed on human suffering.

options.label: D
options.text: The collective term for all negative extraterrestrial and interdimensional species — including Custodians, Reptilians, Greys, and Anuk.
options.rationale: Parasites = umbrella label for the whole suffering-dependent negative ET/interdimensional roster.

questions.hint: Umbrella term — Custodians, Reptilians, Greys, Anuk — feed on suffering.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Anuk (Anunnaki)” refers to highly negative species created by the Custodians, characterized as massive bipedal crocodiles who utilize shape-shifting and actively participate in the brutalization of humanity.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco)”. The report defines “Anuk (Anunnaki)” as: The first successful negative species created by the Custodians, responsible for establishing headquarters in locations like the Grand Canyon and engineering the Grey ETs.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco)”, not “Anuk (Anunnaki)”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Anuk (Anunnaki)”.

questions.question: How are Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco) characterized biologically and operationally?

options.label: A
options.text: Small grey beings with large eyes, created by the Custodians to manage soul recycling and the escort of wiped souls into new vessels at birth.
options.rationale: They are massive bipedal crocodiles who shape-shift and brutalize humanity.

options.label: B
options.text: Tall blond hybrids who staff the Moon station and harvest Loosh from above, rarely coming down to the surface of the realm in person.
options.rationale: They are highly negative massive bipedal crocodile species, not pure light healers.

options.label: C
options.text: Winged beings of light who appear in religious visions, used by the Custodians to direct worship toward Venus and the false gods.
options.rationale: They are living Custodian-created species using shape-shifting in operations.

options.label: D
options.text: Massive bipedal crocodiles created by the Custodians who use shape-shifting and actively take part in the brutalization of humanity.
options.rationale: Omicron/Alpha Draco = massive bipedal crocodile form, shape-shift, active brutalization.

questions.hint: Massive bipedal crocodiles — shape-shifting — brutalization.

questions.question: How do Niberians differ from Reptilians and other active child-harvesting parasites?

options.label: A
options.text: The most powerful, intellectually dominant parasites, free of Custodian rule, who use Black Void Plasma to fake the night sky and do not harvest children.
options.rationale: Niberians = independent intellectual power + Black Void Plasma; not child harvesters.

options.label: B
options.text: They work alongside the Omicron Reptilians in every role, including the flaying of humans during resets, and share the same harvest quotas.
options.rationale: Niberians are distinct: independent, plasma sky tech, not the child-harvest enforcer role.

options.label: C
options.text: They are the weakest of the Custodian servants, never freeing themselves and leaving all sky technology to the Grey ETs instead.
options.rationale: Niberians freed themselves from Custodian rule and supply Black Void Plasma sky tech.

options.label: D
options.text: They specialize in harvesting children beneath the Vatican and leave Black Void Plasma and sky technology to the other species.
options.rationale: They do not actively harvest children; they dominate intellectually and fake the night sky.

questions.hint: Independent — Black Void Plasma sky — do not actively harvest children.

questions.question: What tasks are Greys (Maitrax, Orion Greys, Zetas) assigned?

options.label: A
options.text: Only holographic logos with no Maitrax, Orion, or Zeta operational branches in the field.
options.rationale: Named Grey factions perform real soul and infrastructure operations for the parasites.

options.label: B
options.text: Permanent rebuilders of Spirit Trees who never abduct humans or process reincarnation.
options.rationale: They destroyed the Spirit Tree and run soul recycling and abduction systems.

options.label: C
options.text: Genetically engineered entities tasked with soul recycling, abductions, hauntings, and the destruction of the central Spirit Tree.
options.rationale: Greys = recycle, abduct, haunt, and kill the Spirit Tree as engineered operators.

options.label: D
options.text: Only gardening with no soul recycling, no abductions, no hauntings, and no Spirit Tree role.
options.rationale: Greys handle soul recycling, abductions, hauntings, and destruction of the central Spirit Tree.

questions.hint: Soul recycling, abductions, hauntings, Spirit Tree destruction.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Sold Soul” refers to highly negative species created by the Custodians, characterized as massive bipedal crocodiles who utilize shape-shifting and actively participate in the brutalization of humanity.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco)”. The report defines “Sold Soul” as: A human vessel that has surrendered its energetic autonomy, acting as a host for Demons and serving as an inter-realm "key" for 4th-density parasites to enter the 3rd-density simulation.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “Reptilians (Omicron and Alpha Draco)”, not “Sold Soul”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Sold Soul”.

questions.question: What is Loosh?

options.label: A
options.text: A vitamin that raises frequency and permanently ends all parasitic feeding on humanity.
options.rationale: Loosh is the harvest product of suffering that sustains parasites, not a liberating vitamin.

options.label: B
options.text: An energetic food source generated through human terror, trauma, and suffering, essential for the survival of Demons and Parasites.
options.rationale: Loosh is suffering-energy food that Demons and Parasites require to survive.

options.label: C
options.text: Only digital cryptocurrency with no emotional content and no role feeding Demons.
options.rationale: It is energetic food from trauma and terror, essential to Demons and Parasites.

options.label: D
options.text: Ordinary rainwater stored in barrels for farming with no link to terror or demonic survival.
options.rationale: Loosh is energetic food from human terror, trauma, and suffering — not rainwater.

questions.hint: Energetic food from terror, trauma, and suffering.

questions.question: What is a Sold Soul in the Reptilian/parasite entry system?

options.label: A
options.text: A Taran human who refused every contract and is held in reserve by the parasites to be traded at the next reset.
options.rationale: A Sold Soul surrendered energetic autonomy and hosts Demons as a key for parasites.

options.label: B
options.text: A human vessel that surrendered its energetic autonomy, hosting Demons and serving as an inter-realm key for 4th-density parasites.
options.rationale: Sold Soul = demon host + dimensional key from 4th density into the 3rd-density sim.

options.label: C
options.text: An NPC program that was upgraded into 12th density after completing a bargain with the Reptilian overseers.
options.rationale: Sold Souls enable parasite entry; they are not automatic high-density upgrades.

options.label: D
options.text: A debt contract registered at birth, used to bind a family's wealth to the parasitic banks for several generations.
options.rationale: It is energetic surrender enabling demon hosting and 4th-to-3rd density entry.

questions.hint: Surrendered autonomy — demon host — key for 4th density into 3rd.

questions.question: Is the existence of Reptilians an evolutionary accident?

options.label: A
options.text: They never existed; only textbooks invented them as metaphor for bad weather.
options.rationale: They are real Custodian-created species designed for war and brutalization.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes — they appeared only after the EMF flash as friendly cultural exchange partners.
options.rationale: They were planned for millennia as Custodian enforcers, not post-flash friends.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes — random evolution produced them with no Custodian plan and no warfare design.
options.rationale: Existence is deliberate genetic creation for warfare, genetic manipulation, and brutalization.

options.label: D
options.text: No — it is deliberate genetic creation designed for warfare, genetic manipulation, and the brutalization of Taran Humans.
options.rationale: Not evolution: engineered enforcers for inversion warfare and Taran brutalization.

questions.hint: Not evolution — deliberate genetic enforcers for warfare and brutalization.

questions.question: What defines the 4th density arena where all parasitic entities including Reptilians are confined?

options.label: A
options.text: Automatic 12th-density graduation for every parasite with no kill-or-survive rule.
options.rationale: Parasites are confined to 4th density kill-to-survive conditions, not automatic ascent.

options.label: B
options.text: An arena where life must kill other life to survive — the density band holding all parasitic entities.
options.rationale: 4th density = kill-to-survive confinement for Reptilians and the full parasitic roster.

options.label: C
options.text: An arena of pure unconditional love where no being ever kills and frequency only rises.
options.rationale: 4th density is where life must kill other life to survive.

options.label: D
options.text: A density where only plants exist and no predatory or parasitic behavior is possible.
options.rationale: It is specifically the arena where life must kill other life to survive.

questions.hint: 4th density — life must kill other life to survive.

questions.question: Why did Reptilians mandate destruction of the Spirit Tree (Mt Meru / Hyperborea)?

options.label: A
options.text: Because high vibration makes them violently ill — like a 14-foot tall bipedal crocodile reacting to Kryptonite.
options.rationale: High frequency is Kryptonite to them; kill Spirit Tree → Density Suppression → occupation possible.

options.label: B
options.text: Because high frequency strengthens them, so they built extra Spirit Trees to raise density further.
options.rationale: High vibration makes them violently ill; they destroyed the tree to lower frequency.

options.label: C
options.text: Because G.A.A. ordered them to protect the tree and raise every human into 9th density.
options.rationale: They destroyed the tree to make the plain survivable for low-vibration Reptilian forms.

options.label: D
options.text: Because the Spirit Tree was only a wooden decoration with no effect on realm frequency at all.
options.rationale: Destroying it drastically lowered realm frequency via Density Suppression.

questions.hint: High freq = Kryptonite — destroy Spirit Tree — Density Suppression.

questions.question: How is the Vatican complex structured for Reptilian and parasite operations?

options.label: A
options.text: A G.A.A. free clinic that reverses Adrenochrome harvest and seals every portal permanently.
options.rationale: It is the shared parasitic HQ for slaughter, storage, and portal control — not a G.A.A. clinic.

options.label: B
options.text: Thirteen subterranean levels acting as luxury slaughterhouse, Adrenochrome warehouse, and interdimensional portal hub.
options.rationale: Vatican underworld = 13 levels of harvest and portals; each Reptilian faction holds dedicated levels.

options.label: C
options.text: A single open plaza with no underground levels, no slaughterhouse role, and no portal hub.
options.rationale: It extends thirteen levels below ground as slaughterhouse, Adrenochrome warehouse, and portal hub.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a surface church with no shared parasitic headquarters and no faction-specific vaults.
options.rationale: Parasites share the deep complex; Omicron and Alpha Draco each control specific levels.

questions.hint: 13 levels — slaughter / Adrenochrome / portals — Omicron and Alpha Draco floors.

questions.question: How does Reptilian Shape-Shifting differ from positive higher-density manifestation?

options.label: A
options.text: Shape-shifting is lower-density biological manipulation, fundamentally different from the pure light-form manifestation used by positive higher-density beings.
options.rationale: Reptilian shift = biological low-density trick, not pure high-density light manifestation.

options.label: B
options.text: Reptilians cannot change form at all and only appear as fixed stone idols forever.
options.rationale: They possess shape-shifting as a biological lower-density manipulation ability.

options.label: C
options.text: Only children can see shape-shifts; adults never encounter any biological form change in the field.
options.rationale: Shape-shifting is an operational capability of Reptilians interacting with the human population.

options.label: D
options.text: It is identical pure light-form manifestation used by 12th-density beings with no lower-density biology involved.
options.rationale: Shape-shifting is lower-density biological manipulation, fundamentally different from pure light-form manifestation.

questions.hint: Lower-density biological shape-shift ≠ pure high-density light-form.

questions.question: How did Reptilians and demonic ETs operate during historical Re-sets?

options.label: A
options.text: Through human proxies, while the Reptilians stayed in the Vatican's lower levels and received the Loosh by way of the portals beneath the city.
options.rationale: They operated openly — flaying, raping, and torturing to generate Loosh for demonic counterparts.

options.label: B
options.text: From the Moon station, beaming fear frequencies down onto the population while the Re-set destruction was carried out by energy weapons from above.
options.rationale: They operated openly, including flaying humans alive in front gardens.

options.label: C
options.text: Openly — flaying humans alive in their front gardens, raping, and torturing the populace to generate the Loosh needed to feed their demonic counterparts.
options.rationale: Re-set operations included open garden flaying and torture for demon Loosh supply.

options.label: D
options.text: In disguise as soldiers of the warring nations, so that their violence would be recorded in history as ordinary acts of war rather than as a deliberate harvest of fear.
options.rationale: Open brutalization generated the Loosh needed to feed their demonic counterparts.

questions.hint: Open Re-set violence — flaying in front gardens — Loosh for Demons.

questions.question: Why can Reptilians and other Parasites not create true architecture or souls, and what do they use instead?

options.label: A
options.text: Because they exist at sub-Hertz frequency and lack divine ability to create through conscious intention.
options.rationale: Sub-Hz blocks true creation; clones and Replica-Soul NPCs fake a populated society.

options.label: B
options.text: Because Micro Suns gift them unlimited harmonic power so laboratories stay permanently closed.
options.rationale: They lack divine creative ability and lean on cloning and hive-aligned replica souls.

options.label: C
options.text: Because they only create animals and plants and never touch human population illusion systems.
options.rationale: NPC fabrication with replica souls maintains the illusion of a populated functioning society.

options.label: D
options.text: Because they freely weave true Source souls and never need cloning or NPC fabrication systems.
options.rationale: They cannot sing/weave true souls; they depend on mechanical manufacture and replica souls.

questions.hint: Cannot sing/weave — cloning and hive-aligned Replica-Soul NPCs.

questions.question: How does Reptilian survival intersect with the Amnesia Vortex?

options.label: A
options.text: Reptilians run the Amnesia Vortex on their own, wiping memories at death so the souls can be stored on the Moon station between lives.
options.rationale: Reptilian-grid survival depends on Grey-managed forced reincarnation via the Vortex.

options.label: B
options.text: Reptilians repair the Vortex after each Reset, restoring past-life memories to selected souls who have proved useful to the hierarchy.
options.rationale: The Vortex serves parasitic survival by wiping and recycling, not healing memory.

options.label: C
options.text: The Vortex frees souls at death so Reptilians must harvest the living instead, which is why they depend on adrenochrome so heavily.
options.rationale: Amnesia Vortex forces consciousness back into reincarnation immediately upon death.

options.label: D
options.text: Their survival is linked to the Amnesia Vortex, the Greys' soul-recycling technology that forces souls back into the reincarnation loop at death.
options.rationale: Grey-run Amnesia Vortex recycles souls so the harvest farm never runs out of vessels.

questions.hint: Grey-managed Amnesia Vortex — immediate reincarnation loop for harvest continuity.

questions.question: What is the Moon in the negative ET infrastructure tied to this hierarchy?

options.label: A
options.text: A holographic, Dyson-sphere-like station where negative ETs and blond hybrids harvest Loosh and beam down frequencies that drive "lunatic" behavior.
options.rationale: Moon station = holographic shell over loosh harvest and lunatic frequency projection.

options.label: B
options.text: A natural satellite whose gravity affects the tides of emotion, with the Reptilians timing their harvests to the phases of its cycle.
options.rationale: It is a holographic Dyson-sphere-like space station for loosh harvest and negative frequencies.

options.label: C
options.text: A G.A.A. hospital station that heals children taken during Resets, which the Reptilians have tried to capture for many centuries.
options.rationale: Negative ETs and blond hybrids use it to harvest Loosh and beam negative frequencies.

options.label: D
options.text: A storage depot for the Reptilians' adrenochrome reserves, kept cold in the shadowed craters on the side facing away from the realm.
options.rationale: It is operational negative ET infrastructure for harvest and frequency warfare.

questions.hint: Holographic Dyson-like station — loosh + lunatic frequency beams.

questions.question: How do Overlays, Niberian plasma, and Freemason building work with the Reptilian agenda?

options.label: A
options.text: They restore every Tartarian crystalline temple to full 3rd-density sight for free public use.
options.rationale: Crystalline temples were phased out of 3rd-density sight; Freemason churches replaced them on nodes.

options.label: B
options.text: Freemasons only plant gardens with no nodal churches and no link to energy stifling.
options.rationale: They built crude churches over Nodal Points to stifle natural electromagnetic energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Niberian Black Void Plasma fakes the black night sky and hides true enclosed gateway architecture.
options.rationale: Plasma sky lie + Freemason node churches = hide gateway truth and stifle planetary energy.

options.label: D
options.text: Black Void Plasma brightens the true white sky so everyone sees Tartaria without overlays.
options.rationale: Plasma fakes black night and hides true immovable gateway architecture.

questions.hint: Black Void Plasma sky lie — Freemason churches on nodes — hide Tartaria.

questions.question: What is the current status of Reptilians, and what will the Fake Alien Invasion actually show?

options.label: A
options.text: They upgraded into 12th-density caretakers and will greet humanity as friends during Bluebeam.
options.rationale: They are eradicated from the simulations; invasion craft will be holographic only.

options.label: B
options.text: They never existed, so no holographic invasion theater is planned for any awakening sequence.
options.rationale: They existed and are now eradicated; Fake Alien Invasion still runs as hologram theater.

options.label: C
options.text: Reptilians still rule openly; Bluebeam will feature live Omicron and Custodian landing parties.
options.rationale: Negative entities have been completely eradicated; Bluebeam shows only holographic ET craft.

options.label: D
options.text: Reptilians and the broader parasitic collective have been completely eradicated from the simulations.
options.rationale: Reign ended; Bluebeam is hologram-only scare theater without live Reptilian contact.

questions.hint: Eradicated — Bluebeam is holographic only, not live Reptilian contact.

questions.question: What core societal programming must humanity discard to dissolve residual Reptilian control?

options.label: A
options.text: Nothing — residual programming dissolves automatically without discarding any paradigm.
options.rationale: Final dissolution requires actively discarding the Three Strings of control.

options.label: B
options.text: Pure love and free energy teaching, which were the only strings parasites ever installed.
options.rationale: Parasites installed Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge — not liberating love/energy as strings.

options.label: C
options.text: The Three Strings of control: Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge (such as the Heliocentric globe earth deception).
options.rationale: Discard Religion, Finance, and false Perceived Knowledge to break residual fear programming.

options.label: D
options.text: Only cooking recipes, with no link to Religion, Finance, or Perceived Knowledge systems.
options.rationale: The Three Strings are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge (including heliocentric deception).

questions.hint: Three Strings — Religion, Finance, Perceived Knowledge.

questions.question: Who enforced the Three Strings for the parasites, and what geographic truth frees a soul from residual fear programming?

options.label: A
options.text: Micro Suns enforced the strings to imprison Tarans; freedom requires worshipping heliocentrism harder.
options.rationale: Parasite Freemason proxies enforced the strings; flat enclosed plain knowing is liberating.

options.label: B
options.text: 33rd-degree Freemason proxies enforced Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.
options.rationale: Freemason 33rd-degree proxies ran the strings; flat enclosed plain truth breaks residual Reptilian fear code.

options.label: C
options.text: No proxies existed; the plain is a spinning globe and Freemasons only baked bread historically.
options.rationale: Freemason proxies enforced control strings; true geometry is flat enclosed plain, not globe.

options.label: D
options.text: Only random children enforced the strings; freedom requires defending the spinning globe forever.
options.rationale: 33rd-degree Freemasons enforced the strings; globe deception is part of Perceived Knowledge to discard.

questions.hint: 33rd-degree Freemasons — Three Strings — true flat enclosed plain.
